app.name: DisplayGroups
language.name: English
confirm.title: Keep these display settings?
confirm.body: Switched to “{group}”. Reverting to the previous layout in {seconds} s.
osd.dryRun: Dry run: displays were not changed
tray.settingsMissing: The settings app is not installed in this build yet.
common.saved: Saved. The agent picks up the changes by itself.
common.notSaved: Not saved: fix the problems marked in red first.
common.unsavedClose: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
common.changedOnDisk: The settings were changed outside this window. Your unsaved edits here are kept.
settings.title: DisplayGroups
groups.empty: No groups yet. Choose “New group” and add its displays, or arrange your displays in Windows and choose “Capture current setup”.
groups.testing: Switching to “{name}”. Keep or revert it in the dialog.
groups.valid: Windows accepts this group ({strategy}). Nothing was changed.
groups.invalid: Windows would reject this group right now. Nothing was changed.
groups.updateFromScreenHint: Replace this group's displays with what Windows shows now
groups.updateConfirm: Replace the displays of “{name}” with what Windows shows now? Its name, icon, hotkeys and other options stay.
groups.reverted: “{name}” was not kept; the previous layout is back.
groups.applyFailed: Could not switch to “{name}”; the error message says why.
groups.savedOnScreen: Saved. “{name}” is on screen now: apply the changes to Windows too?
editor.overlap: Displays cannot overlap; the move was undone.
editor.modesWhenOn: This display is off, so its modes cannot be listed. Type them, or turn it on to pick from a list.
editor.noDisplays: No displays yet. Use “Add a display…” below for each display this group turns on; the first one is the main display. A display can be added while it is off.
editor.identifyHint: Show each display's number on that display for a few seconds
icons.pickTitle: Choose an icon for this group
actions.after: After a switch is kept, open or start:
hotkeys.intro: Shortcuts work anywhere while the DisplayGroups agent runs. Ctrl+Alt with an F-key rarely clashes with games.
hotkeys.lockScreenOff: Turn on lock-screen support in Settings first.
hotkeys.notActive: Some DisplayGroups hotkeys are not active:
triggers.intro: Switch to a group when a program starts or a game controller connects, and back when it ends. The DisplayGroups agent does this while it runs.
triggers.programsHint: File names such as eldenring.exe, separated by commas. Any one of them counts.
triggers.windowTitle: Only when a window title contains
triggers.windowTitleHint: Optional. For example "Big Picture" with steam.exe.
triggers.switchBack: Switch back when it ends, after
triggers.revertDelay: Seconds to wait before switching back
triggers.switchBackHint: To the group that was on screen before. The wait covers launchers that restart the game.
triggers.confirmHint: Off is recommended: otherwise the switch is undone unless you click Keep within 15 s.
triggers.edgeHint: Automatic switching reacts to changes: a program that is already running when the agent starts does not switch.
shortcuts.intro: A shortcut switches to its group with one double-click. It uses the saved settings.
shortcuts.pinHint: To pin one, right-click it in Start and choose “Pin to Start”.
settings.languageHint: More languages appear when their file is added to the locales folder.
settings.startWithWindowsHint: Runs the agent (hotkeys, tray, on-screen display) when you sign in.
settings.startMinimizedHint: Off opens this window when the agent starts.
settings.osd: Show the on-screen display after switching
settings.protocolHint: For Stream Deck, macros and automation tools. This user only.
settings.fallback: When every display disconnects, switch to
settings.fallbackHint: For example back to the desk monitors when the TV is unplugged.
settings.lockScreenHint: Needs the installer's optional lock-screen service.
diagnostics.importRejected: The file has problems and was not imported (see below).
diagnostics.noStatus: Display information is not available right now.
groups.appliedAsk: Switched to “{name}”. GNOME asks whether to keep it.
hotkeys.usedByGnome: GNOME already uses this key for {what}.
triggers.windowTitleLinux: GNOME does not tell apps the titles of other windows, so this trigger does not start on Linux. Clear the field to use it.
settings.startWithWindowsHint@linux: Runs the agent (tray icon, automatic switching, notifications) when you log in.
groups.empty@linux: No groups yet. Choose “New group” and add its displays, or arrange your displays in GNOME Settings and choose “Capture current setup”.
groups.valid@linux: GNOME accepts this group. Nothing was changed.
groups.invalid@linux: GNOME would reject this group right now. Nothing was changed.
groups.updateFromScreenHint@linux: Replace this group's displays with what is on screen now
groups.updateConfirm@linux: Replace the displays of “{name}” with what is on screen now? Its name, icon, hotkeys and other options stay.
groups.savedOnScreen@linux: Saved. “{name}” is on screen now: apply the changes to the displays too?
editor.confirm@linux: Ask whether to keep the new layout
editor.confirmHint@linux: GNOME asks, and goes back after 20 seconds without an answer. Off switches at once; GNOME then brings back its saved layout at the next login.
editor.modesWhenOn@linux: This display is not connected, so its modes cannot be listed. Type them, or connect it to pick from a list.
hotkeys.intro@linux: Each hotkey becomes one of GNOME's own shortcuts (Settings → Keyboard → Custom Shortcuts), so it works even when the agent is not running. GNOME keeps Ctrl+Alt+F1…F12 for the text consoles; Super+Shift with an F-key is usually free.
triggers.programsHint@linux: Program names such as steam or eldenring.exe, separated by commas. Any one of them counts.
shortcuts.pinHint@linux: To keep one in the dock, right-click it in the app grid and choose “Pin to Dash”.
triggers.confirmHint@linux: Off is recommended: otherwise GNOME asks whether to keep it and undoes the switch after 20 seconds without an answer.
